notes.title: New demo 0.7 is a live! And you will be able to pet such a sweet kitty.
notes.content:
Hi!
I wanted to announce that Lofi got a new demo v0.7.
In the game, you will be able to pet such a sweet kitty. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40257744/a1fef7b38c3088a081b00dda87348bd1e72c4463.png[/img]

I fixed the bathroom, the animations and some nonsense in the code. 
I am testing a new system of satisfying needs. 
And I'm working on elements for a procedural story.

 The demo will be updated on a regular basis.

I'm sorry for waiting so long for the game but I don't want to cheat anyone. 
I am a fresh dad, I work on the game after hours when my son is asleep.

I'd like to know your opinion on this demo version.
Greetings!
